title: Tama's Reward
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kano (Kanoko) spent elementary and middle school at all-girls schools and has a strong fascination with boys. At her new co-ed high school she daydreams constantly about interacting with them, and finds herself drawn to Tamao, the blunt, strange genius boy at the next desk. A first-love romantic comedy between high-school classmates built on her delusions and his oddness.
life_message: First love is awkward and funny, and real connection grows out of getting to know an actual person rather than a fantasy.
